text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I sent Dana the list in her direct message. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

- **#PD-4492:** in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. At the Eau Claire yard, gatehouse kiosks weren't texting bay assignments to drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it the same day, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift got through the gate. One follow-up is open: archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
- **#4419:** in "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea also filed this one. Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware. The note has no date, so I can't say how current that status is.

I read all six of Moss's notes. I also told Dana what I left out and why:
- The 9/14 North pipeline digest and the 3/23 renewal check-in both talk about Quarrendon Freight Lines but give no ticket numbers.
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central handoffs digest are for Marrow accounts.
- Quarendon Freightways (spelled with one "r") is a different company and not a Pemberline customer.

I only looked at public files that Dana can open herself. Ticket numbers aren't finance figures, so nothing here needed approval.
